visualCharacteristics.variantDescriptor: Stacked rows of image left / rich text right (heading, paragraphs, lists) at about 50/50.
visualCharacteristics.sectionStylingNotes: Pale lavender-blue (#f1f3ff) inset panel. Two rows, each image left (about half width) and text right: H2 + paragraphs; second row adds a bulleted list with inline underlined links.

contentPattern.structure: one row per media pair: cell 1 image; cell 2 rich text (H2, paragraphs, optional lists)
contentPattern.description: Row 1: team discussion image | "We honor your choices" + 2 paragraphs. Row 2: woman on laptop image | "Committed to your privacy" + paragraph + 3-item bullet list with links

usage: Use for alternating-content style sections where each row pairs a photo with a heading and rich text; often placed in a light-blue section.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for image-plus-text rows. Image cell position is preserved as authored on desktop and stacked first on mobile.
